description: Enceintes contenant un ou plusieurs postes électriques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Délégation RTE Auvergne Rhône-Alpes. This file presents as of June 10, 2024, for Metropolitan France, all enclosures containing one or more substations. Coverage: Délégation RTE Auvergne Rhône-Alpes. The portal shows the English title as "Speakers containing one or more substations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Délégation RTE Auvergne Rhône-Alpes. Its keywords include reseaux-de-transport, inspire, electricite. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS, OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
